title: Coordinate junta approximation
statement: For a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube and a set of coordinates $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, define its coordinate junta approximation by applying the sign threshold map to the coordinate projection of $f$ onto $J$ at each input.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
caveat: The definitions of the coordinate projection and sign threshold map are not included, so the construction cannot be stated more precisely from this snippet alone.
